WITH subcategory_sales AS (
    SELECT
        pc.ProductCategoryName AS product_category,
        ps.ProductSubcategoryName AS product_subcategory,
        sum(fos.SalesAmount) AS online_sales_amount
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales AS fos
    INNER JOIN retail.DimProduct AS p
        ON fos.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
    INNER JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory AS ps
        ON toInt32(p.ProductSubcategoryKey) = ps.ProductSubcategoryKey
    INNER JOIN retail.DimProductCategory AS pc
        ON ps.ProductCategoryKey = pc.ProductCategoryKey
    WHERE toYear(fos.DateKey) = 2009
    GROUP BY
        pc.ProductCategoryName,
        ps.ProductSubcategoryName
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        product_category,
        product_subcategory,
        online_sales_amount,
        row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY product_category ORDER BY online_sales_amount DESC) AS rn
    FROM subcategory_sales
)
SELECT
    product_category,
    product_subcategory,
    online_sales_amount
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY product_category
